title: Q4 Product Roadmap & AI Secretary Launch
summary: Reviewed final deliverables for the AI Meeting Secretary release. Confirmed live audio streaming stability, export to Word/PDF formats, and guest mode security safeguards. Team agreed on rolling out beta to 250 enterprise design partners next Tuesday.
topics: Live browser audio capture & noise cancellation
Word (.docx) and PDF export formatting validation
Design partner rollout schedule & feedback telemetry
decisions: Confirmed public launch target for October 15th
Approved guest mode ephemeral session model without data persistence
Selected Gemini 3.8 Flash as the primary multimodal meeting intelligence engine

actionItems.task: Conduct load testing on concurrent 60MB audio uploads
